verdict.rationale: Penpot's self-host docs explicitly state 'Keep your data private. Penpot will never make business out of your data. Choose where and how to host it,' which directly addresses preventing data from being used for AI training by keeping it entirely under user control. However, this is a general privacy claim tied to self-hosting rather than an explicit AI-training opt-out policy or contractual clause, and there's no independent/third-party corroboration of this specific promise. missing for 10: explicit AI-training-specific policy/ToS language, independent verification of the no-training claim, and clarity on cloud-hosted (non-self-hosted) instance data usage.
